title: Uranium Energy Corp
summary: US uranium producer and processor with ISR and conventional assets.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Uranium Energy Corp holds uranium projects in the US, Canada and Paraguay, and owns a processing plant in Wyoming. It is restarting production to supply US utilities and government stockpiles. Uranium prices and permitting determine the pace.

Technology Exposure

  • Uranium mining and processing
  • US strategic uranium reserves
  • Exploration projects

What To Watch

  • Production restart
  • Uranium prices
  • Permitting

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
